author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: FriendlyElec has introduced the NanoPC-T6 Plus, a compact single-board computer built around the Rockchip RK3588 processor. The platform integrates an octa-core CPU, LPDDR5 memory, and multiple high-speed interfaces, supporting applications such as edge computing, networking, and multimedia processing. title: NanoPC-T6 Plus brings RK3588 to compact SBC with dual 2.5GbE
